title: Conditions of Contract: The Smallwares Share on Closure of a Workplace Cafe
content:
These conditions govern the smallwares share borne on a cafe management contract held under the Workplace Cafe Management Program.

1. Where the cafe has stood suspended for ten or more calendar days in the current contract year and a day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the smallwares share is one half.

2. Where the cafe has stood suspended for fewer than ten calendar days in the current contract year and a day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the smallwares share is the whole.

3. Otherwise the smallwares share is nil, and where no day of written notice of termination stands on the contract that third case governs, so that no part of the smallwares allowance is borne as a share.

4. In figures, one half is a smallwares share of 50 per cent and the whole is a smallwares share of 100 per cent.

5. The days on which the cafe has stood suspended are counted as calendar days falling within the current contract year, whether they run together or fall apart in that year, and the count is taken as the contract record shows it.

6. The count divides at 10 calendar days. A cafe that has stood suspended for 10 calendar days in the current contract year with a day of written notice of termination standing on the contract answers condition 1 and bears a smallwares share of one half; a cafe that has stood suspended for 9 such calendar days with that day of notice standing answers condition 2 and bears a smallwares share of the whole.

7. Each of conditions 1 and 2 is answered only where both of its limbs hold. A cafe that has stood suspended for 14 calendar days in the current contract year while no day of written notice of termination stands on the contract answers neither, and condition 3 governs.
